ops.text: PreToolUse:Bash hook wrong-fire (2026-10-02, cc-remote fresh-startup-92s): a `run_in_background` Bash call running only `gh run watch <id> --exit-status; gh run view <id> --json jobs` was blocked with "Run `retro.py prose` and `design.py plainify` in the foreground, never with `&`, `nohup`, `setsid`, or `run_in_background`". The command never mentions retro.py or design.py, so the guard's matcher is too broad (likely fires on any run_in_background). Workaround: Monitor poll loop.
